1: A dense, tangled grove smells of crushed leaves and ripe berries. Medicinal fungi glimmer beneath the roots. Roll Herb Gathering Checks. An old trail marker, its paint bleached nearly white, leans among the brambles. Birds pick at the last fruit above the party's heads.
2: A rusted lockbox lies half-buried beneath collapsed beams, its seams packed with dirt and old leaves. A faded depot stamp is barely visible beneath the rust; whatever was stored inside has been sealed away from weather and scavengers for generations. DC 13 Thieves' Tools; success = 1d4 rations + luxury item. Failure = 1d4 rations.
3: Thick Veil mist presses between the trees, swallowing the trail beyond 30 ft and distorting nearby shapes. Visibility is 30 ft and Perception checks have Disadvantage. DC 12 Survival; success = maintain pace. Failure = disoriented and lose 1 hex.
4: The ash-buried shell of a generator housing protrudes from the earth, its cracked panels humming beneath the dust. The stenciled warning labels have blistered away, and a dead control panel flickers once when the party draws near. DC 13 Tinker's Tools; success = Amber Charge Bundle. Failure = 8d6 force damage.
5: A fresh collapse has torn open the ravine path, leaving loose stone and broken roots underfoot. DC 12 Athletics/Acrobatics; success = proceed normally. Failure = 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
6: A Pre-Sundered chapel stands quiet beneath a roof of overgrown branches. Faded murals survive behind the altar, where a small vessel of holy water rests beneath a fall of plaster. Dusty pews lie scattered across the floor, and the old bell rope hangs in tatters. DC 12 Religion; success = next Death Save auto-success. Failure = 1d4 bludgeoning damage.
7: An old irrigation channel cuts through the undergrowth, its stone banks slick with moss and damp with clean water. Roll Herb Gathering Checks.
8: An ash-buried armory wagon lies split open, its scorched contents scattered among the roots. Its painted insignia is charred beyond recognition, and warped ammunition tins crunch underfoot. Something intact glints beneath the buckled chassis. DC 14 Tinker's Tools; success = Emerald Charge Grenade + bullets. Failure = 3d6 piercing damage (shrapnel).
9: A skeleton rests against a tree with a waterlogged logbook clutched to its ribs. A cracked pair of spectacles still hangs from its collar, and a corroded surveyor's badge is pinned to its coat. Most ink has run from the logbook, but the last page was folded inside the cover. DC 12 Investigation; success = decode note pointing to hidden stockpile (Rations/Munitions/Materials). Failure = book tradable to Archivists.
10: A swollen river has broken its banks and erased the path. The far shore is visible through the rain-dark trees. DC 12 Athletics/Acrobatics; success = cross safely. Failure = lose 1 hex.
11: Pulsing fungi cluster beside a narrow Veil seep, their faint light staining the wet bark around them. Their glow brightens and fades like a slow lantern signal beneath the canopy. Roll Herb Gathering Checks.
12: A shattered altar lies blackened beneath the trees. A residue-darkened symbol remains on its face, cold to the touch. DC 12 Religion; success = remove 1 Exhaustion or Frightened. Failure = 1d4 poison damage.
13: A Veil-twisted tree has fallen across the trail, its trunk corded with unnatural roots. DC 11 Athletics; success = clear path + salvage timber. Failure = lose 1 hex.
14: A collapsed field lab hides beneath creeping vines. A dormant processor ticks faintly behind its cracked casing. Shattered glass crunches in the doorway; the remaining cabinets are rusted shut and their labels have faded to ghosts. DC 13 Tinker's Tools; success = gain Perception Advantage in hex. Failure = trigger encounter and lose 1 hex.
15: Silver-leafed shrubs ring a spring sheltered beneath interlocking roots. Their leaves catch the light like hammered metal. Water beads on the leaves and runs clear over the stones, while the woods beyond the spring are thick with shadow. Roll Herb Gathering Checks.
16: A broken Omen Machine prototype rests in the mud, its exposed core spitting blue arcs into the undergrowth. Its maker's plate has been torn away, leaving bolt holes and a web of cracked sigils across the casing. DC 15 Arcana; success = extract Hollowed Residuum. Failure = 3d6 force damage.
17: A shattered power cell leaks residue into the soil, lighting the nearby roots from within. The cell's warning stencil is still legible beneath the grime, though its casing has split and warped. DC 14 Tinker's Tools; success = restore 1 2nd-level or 2 1st-level spell slots. Failure = 1d4 force damage.
18: Fresh tracks cross a dry creek bed and disappear beneath the brush. They may lead to food—or to something hunting nearby. DC 12 Survival; success = gain +1d4 rations. Failure = trigger combat.
19: A collapsed overhang offers a shallow pocket of shelter beneath stone and tangled roots. DC 12 Perception; success = improve the randomly determined rest location by one category, up to Safe. Failure = no improvement.
20: A buried Bastion cache bears a faded insignia beneath a layer of leaf mold. The lid is bowed but intact, and a strip of oilcloth still clings to its seam. Something inside gives off a faint metallic warmth. Gain 1 Bastion Resource. DC 12 Survival/Investigation; success = also find 1d4 Hollowed Residuum. Failure = lose 1 hex.
